# `passportsim ble_gatt`

Run the scripted BLE central's GATT client, or take its btsnoop capture.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `radio` |
| MCP tool | `passport_ble_gatt` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/ble_gatt` |
| Scenario step | `ble.gatt` |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `advances_time`, `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim ble_gatt [op] [--artifact] [--contains <CONTAINS>] [--enabled] [--handle <HANDLE>] [--indicate] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--label <LABEL>] [--secrets] [--settle-ms <SETTLE_MS>] [--text <TEXT>] [--timeout-ms <TIMEOUT_MS>] [--uuid <UUID>] [--value <VALUE>] [--wall-budget-ms <WALL_BUDGET_MS>] [--with-response] [--within-ms <WITHIN_MS>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact` | `--artifact` | `boolean` | no | `capture`: write the btsnoop file; `--no-artifact` reports the counters only. |
| `contains` | `--contains <CONTAINS>` | `string` | no | Hex bytes a `notifications` call waits for. |
| `enabled` | `--enabled` | `boolean` | no | `capture`: record packets from now on, or stop and drop what is held. |
| `handle` | `--handle <HANDLE>` | `integer` | no | Characteristic Value Handle, as a discover reported it. |
| `indicate` | `--indicate` | `boolean` | no | Subscribe to indications rather than notifications. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `label` | `--label <LABEL>` | `string` | no | `capture`: the artifact's file stem under ble/. |
| `op` | `<op>` | `"discover"` \| `"read"` \| `"write"` \| `"subscribe"` \| `"notifications"` \| `"capture"` | no | The GATT operation; the default is discover. |
| `secrets` | `--secrets` | `boolean` | no | `capture`: record with the key material kept, for a pairing trace. Taints the instance, so `snapshot export` then needs the confirmation, and drops what the capture already holds. |
| `settle_ms` | `--settle-ms <SETTLE_MS>` | `integer` | no | `notifications`: let this much virtual time pass, then report what arrived. |
| `text` | `--text <TEXT>` | `string` | no | The bytes as UTF-8 text instead of hex. |
| `timeout_ms` | `--timeout-ms <TIMEOUT_MS>` | `integer` | no | Virtual time this call may spend before E_TIMEOUT. |
| `uuid` | `--uuid <UUID>` | `string` | no | Characteristic UUID. |
| `value` | `--value <VALUE>` | `string` | no | Hex bytes to write. |
| `wall_budget_ms` | `--wall-budget-ms <WALL_BUDGET_MS>` | `integer` | no | Host time this call may spend before E_WALL_BUDGET. |
| `with_response` | `--with-response` | `boolean` | no | ATT_WRITE_REQ rather than ATT_WRITE_CMD; `--no-with-response` sends ATT_WRITE_CMD. |
| `within_ms` | `--within-ms <WITHIN_MS>` | `integer` | no | How long a `notifications` wait runs. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/ble_gatt.input.json`](../schema/commands/ble_gatt.input.json).

## Examples

### Discover the services and characteristics of the connected peer

```sh
passportsim ble_gatt --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "op": "discover"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "op": "discover"
}
'@ | passportsim ble_gatt --json -
```

### Subscribe to the Passport Keys events characteristic

```sh
passportsim ble_gatt --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "op": "subscribe",
  "uuid": "12D4FA09-7418-48FA-A95A-B43A2E669E55"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "op": "subscribe",
  "uuid": "12D4FA09-7418-48FA-A95A-B43A2E669E55"
}
'@ | passportsim ble_gatt --json -
```

### Write a command line and wait for its answer

```sh
passportsim ble_gatt --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "op": "write",
  "text": "{\"cmd\":\"ping\"}\n",
  "uuid": "12D4FA0A-7418-48FA-A95A-B43A2E669E55"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "op": "write",
  "text": "{\"cmd\":\"ping\"}\n",
  "uuid": "12D4FA0A-7418-48FA-A95A-B43A2E669E55"
}
'@ | passportsim ble_gatt --json -
```

### Write the btsnoop capture as an artifact

```sh
passportsim ble_gatt --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "label": "gatt",
  "op": "capture"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "label": "gatt",
  "op": "capture"
}
'@ | passportsim ble_gatt --json -
```

### Record the key material too, for a pairing trace, which taints the instance

```sh
passportsim ble_gatt --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "artifact": false,
  "op": "capture",
  "secrets": true
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "artifact": false,
  "op": "capture",
  "secrets": true
}
'@ | passportsim ble_gatt --json -
```
